items.summary: U.S. cleared ~10 Chinese firms to buy Nvidia H200 chips but zero deliveries have occurred as of May 14, 2026. Nvidia controls 81% of AI data center chip market; NVIDIA H100 GPU waits hit 6-12 months at peak demand in 2024. AI chip market hit $120B in 2025, triple 2023 levels, with custom AI chips from hyperscalers growing rapidly.

news.title: U.S. clears H200 chip sales to 10 China firms as Nvidia CEO looks for breakthrough
The Evidence Is Piling Up: Nvidia's AI Chip Dominance May Be About to Come to an End

items.summary: U.S. secured largest-ever HALEU shipment (1.7 metric tons) from Japan on May 7, 2026, advancing next-generation reactor fuel supply. GE Vernova and Hitachi signed MOU for BWRX-300 small modular reactor deployment in Southeast Asia. Spot uranium price reached $86.55/lb on May 1, 2026, up 24% year-over-year.

news.title: U.S. Secures Largest-Ever HALEU Shipment to Power American Nuclear Industry

items.summary: U.S. defense spending rose 17%+ in FY2026 to $1.05 trillion. Trump administration proposed $1.5 trillion defense budget for FY2027, roughly 40% increase. Global defense spending reached $2.63 trillion in 2025, up from $2.48 trillion in 2024, with strong increases in Europe and Middle East.

items.summary: Gartner predicts 40% of enterprise apps will feature task-specific AI agents by end of 2026, up from <5% in 2025. Agentic AI market projected to grow at 53% CAGR from $8.5B in 2026 to $45B by 2030. Google expanded Forward Deployed Engineer program on May 12, 2026 to help enterprises move agentic AI from pilots to production.

Oral Wegovy had 135,000 prescriptions by late April 2026. Novo Nordisk partnered with OpenAI for enterprise-wide AI integration targeting full implementation by end of 2026.

Bessemer Venture noted 'GPT-2.5 moment for robotics' in May 2026. Boston Dynamics unveiled Electric Atlas at CES 2026. ~$6B flowed into world model companies in Q1 2026 alone. China placed robotics at core of 15th Five-Year Plan.

items.summary: IEA projects 30% copper supply deficit by 2035; demand hit 27M tonnes in 2024, growing to 37M by 2050. Refined copper demand rose 3.2% in 2024; BloombergNEF warns structural deficit may start in 2026. Copper prices up 40% in 2025 (largest annual gain since 2009). AI data centers creating additional demand pressures.

news.title: Copper's tight supply and tariff risks set for a volatile 2026

items.summary: Canada's TELUS-government partnership advancing sovereign AI data centres on May 11, 2026. Asia Pacific governments ranked Sovereign AI as 2nd-highest investment priority (IDC May 2026 survey of 360 IT decision-makers). Global spending on sovereign AI systems projected to exceed $100B by 2026. Red Hat-Core42 collaboration announced for UAE sovereign AI on May 11, 2026.
